_README: SANITIZED TEMPLATE. Replace every <PLACEHOLDER> with a local value before running; nothing here is a live account, path, or secret. Substrate-A (Snowflake) targets are templates only -- the host is <SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT>, the OAuth secret is read from $SF_SECRET at runtime and is NEVER stored in this file. Binary/data paths use <PLACEHOLDER> tokens (point them at your local worktrees). Substrate-B (MinIO) uses minioadmin/minioadmin, the documented local MinIO default (not a real secret). See ../PROTOCOL.md and ../substrate/README.md.

duckdb-parquet-sf01.note: DuckDB-DIRECT FLOOR: raw source parquet, no catalog. Fast local ceiling; NO fluree counterpart (fluree reads only catalog-fronted Iceberg). Role: the DuckDB answer for JOIN pairs is taken here (asymmetric-substrate, labeled) when duckdb-iceberg can't join over a catalog. Native arm64 via arch -arm64 (Rosetta penalty otherwise).

duckdb-iceberg-sf01.note: SUBSTRATE A TEMPLATE: DuckDB iceberg ext ATTACHing a Snowflake Polaris REST catalog. Secret read from env $SF_SECRET (NEVER stored). Multi-file partitioned FACT scans currently fail here on Snowflake-managed S3 (see PROTOCOL.md 'substrate field discipline' + issue #1568); this target reliably carries only catalog/manifest ops (bare COUNT) + small single-file dims. JOIN pairs additionally hit the bloom gap -- use duckdb-iceberg-sf01-nopushdown for one capped remote attempt.

duckdb-iceberg-sf01-nopushdown.note: SUBSTRATE A join workaround TEMPLATE: join_filter_pushdown disabled so JOINs don't hit the bloom-filter gap -- but this removes the semi-join reduction (remote over-scan). One capped attempt per join pair, hard-cap 180s; on timeout record DNF. Disclosed handicap, never a headline number.

duckdb-iceberg-minio-sf01.note: SUBSTRATE B (engine-pure, local): DuckDB over the local MinIO-backed Iceberg REST fixture (see ../substrate/). AUTHORIZATION_TYPE/ACCESS_DELEGATION_MODE none + our own S3 secret bypass the vended-cred path; unpartitioned single-file tables sidestep the many-small-files fan-out that broke substrate A. minioadmin is the documented local MinIO default. Runs the DATA-scanning wave (single-table AND joins) both engines can run.

duckdb-iceberg-minio-sf01-part.note: SUBSTRATE B PARTITIONED (Wave B probe): one fact table written PARTITIONED BY date onto the same MinIO/REST fixture (namespace DW_SF01_PART). Isolates whether substrate A's fact-scan failure is many-small-files-over-Snowflake-S3-specific vs a general partitioning weakness, and whether the bloom-filter JOIN gap is triggered by the partitioned multi-file layout. See ../substrate/load_tables_partitioned.py + issue #1568.

fluree-minio-sf01-main.note: SUBSTRATE B Fluree leg on SHIPPED MAIN. Representative current-shipped engine. Main does NOT carry #1528 filter-over-join fusion, so the filtered-join pair declines here. Registration: fluree iceberg map enterprise-sf01-b --mode rest --catalog-uri http://127.0.0.1:8181 --r2rml ../substrate/enterprise-sf01-mapping.ttl --s3-endpoint http://127.0.0.1:9000 --s3-path-style --no-vended-credentials (127.0.0.1 not localhost -> IPv4; omit --warehouse -> empty REST prefix). engine_version auto-derived per row from the binary's worktree git commit.

fluree-minio-sf01-1528.note: SUBSTRATE B Fluree leg WITH #1528 filter-over-join fusion (family-C). The representative-of-the-fix engine; the filtered-join pair collapses to fused-class (~sub-second) here. Same registration + mapping as fluree-minio-sf01-main. engine_version auto-derived per row.
